messages.text: My knee is acting up again after basketball on Sunday.
It's swollen on the inside and hurts when I go down stairs.
Should I put ice or heat on it?
How long do sprains like this usually take to heal?
Ok, I'll rest it this week.
Different subject: I'm planning a trip to Samaná in February to see the whales.
Do you know which month is best for the humpbacks?
We'd stay three nights, probably in Las Terrenas.
Is the boat tour from Samaná town worth it?
The billing migrations are failing with a circular dependency between invoices and customers.
Migration 0003 in invoices needs customers 0002, and customers 0002 needs invoices 0003.
Can I just merge them into one migration?
Or should I move the foreign key into a later migration?
Ok, moving the customer foreign key to 0004 worked, tests pass.
I'm starving. What's a quick lunch I can make with rice, eggs, and some leftover chicken?
I don't have soy sauce though.
Would a fried rice still taste good without it?
Great, making that now.

sessions.name: wedding speech, wandering inside one topic

messages.text: Pedro asked me to give a speech as his best man at the wedding in Puerto Plata.
Half the guests only speak English because the bride is from Boston.
I'm thinking of telling the story of when we got lost on Pico Duarte as kids.
How long should a best man speech be?
Also, the dress code is white linen, guayaberas for the men.
Where can I buy a good guayabera in Santo Domingo?
And should I bring a gift even though I'm in the wedding party?
What do people usually give at Dominican weddings?

sessions.name: budget, then the dog, then back to money

messages.text: Carolina and I want to save for a down payment on a house.
We can put away about 20,000 pesos a month right now.
The houses we like cost around 6 million pesos.
How much of a down payment do banks usually ask for here?
By the way, Canela has been scratching nonstop since yesterday.
The vet thinks it might be a food allergy to chicken.
We have to switch her to a salmon-based food for eight weeks.
Are salmon dog foods expensive?
Back to the house: should we open a separate savings account for it?
Banreservas offers 4% on fixed-term deposits, is that good?
Estoy organizando el cumpleaños 70 de mi mamá en Baní para el 14 de noviembre.
Vamos a ser unas cuarenta personas, casi todos familia.
Mi prima va a hacer el bizcocho y pensamos servir sancocho.
¿Cuánto sancocho necesito para cuarenta personas?
¿Y cuántas libras de carne serían?
Cambiando de tema, mañana tengo una entrevista para un puesto de analista en una empresa de energía solar.
Es en Punta Cana, tendría que mudarme.
¿Qué preguntas suelen hacer en esas entrevistas?
¿Y cómo negocio el salario si me hacen una oferta?

sessions.name: cours de piano, puis la voisine

messages.text: Je commence des cours de piano le mardi soir au conservatoire.
Je n'ai jamais joué d'un instrument avant.
Mon objectif est de jouer une valse de Chopin d'ici un an.
Combien de temps faut-il pratiquer chaque jour au début ?
Est-ce qu'un clavier numérique suffit pour commencer ?
Autre chose : ma voisine part en Martinique et me laisse son chat Moustache.
Il est intolérant au lactose, donc pas de lait.
Il faut changer la litière tous les deux jours.
Elle revient le 2 novembre.
Staging went down during Friday's deploy.
The disk was full, almost 40 GB of gunicorn logs.
Nobody had set up log rotation on that server.
Andrés from infrastructure is adding logrotate now.
Should we also send the logs to a central place instead of keeping them on disk?
What would that cost with something like Grafana Loki?
And how long should we keep them?
Ok, I'll write it up for the team.
I'm making my grandmother's sancocho for my coworkers on Saturday.
Her secret was a lot of cilantro and adding the auyama early so it thickens.
I need it to feed about twelve people.
Should I use chicken, pork, and longaniza, or just two meats?
Can I make it the night before?
Unrelated, I just finished reading One Hundred Years of Solitude.
The ending with the parchments blew my mind.
What should I read next by García Márquez?
Is Love in the Time of Cholera very different?

sessions.name: car trouble without announcing the switch

messages.text: My car died on the Autopista Duarte yesterday and I had to call a tow truck.
Ramón, my mechanic, says it's the fuel pump.
He quoted 18,000 pesos with labor.
Is that a fair price for a fuel pump on a 2015 Corolla?
My brother-in-law is lending me his jeep until Friday.
What's the best way to learn Python if I already know some JavaScript?
I want to automate some reports at work.
Should I learn pandas right away?
Any good free course?
My landlord in Naco keeps delaying the repairs on the water heater.
It's been three weeks without hot water.
The lease says urgent repairs should be done within a day.
Can I withhold rent until he fixes it?
What if I pay a plumber myself and deduct it?
I'm also thinking about just leaving early.
There's a two-month penalty for breaking the lease though.
Would the lack of repairs let me avoid the penalty?

sessions.name: sister moving, then her classes, then my run

messages.text: My sister Lucía just moved to Montreal for a nursing job.
She starts at the hospital next Monday.
She's nervous about her French.
She signed up for evening French classes.
Do you think she'll manage with patients in French after a few months?
I want to run a 10K in March, can you make me a training plan?
Right now I run about 3 kilometers twice a week.
My knee sometimes hurts after long runs.
Should I add strength training too?
Priya set the customer portal launch for November 14.
Tomas owns the Stripe integration.
We still need a penetration test before go-live.
Securalis can't start before November 17.
So the launch will probably move to December 5.
How do I tell the client without making it sound like our fault?
Should I propose a beta for a few customers in November?
Draft me a short email to Priya about it.
